mechanics.claim: The passive triggers Call of the Freljord when Nunu and Willump deal damage against an enemy champion, large monster, or structure.
mechanics.quote: When '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' deal damage against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|turrets|structure}}, they and a nearby allied champion gain ''Call of the Freljord''

mechanics.claim: Successive triggers while the buff is active extend its duration by 4 seconds each, up to a 44 second remaining-duration cap.
mechanics.quote: Successive triggers of ''Call of the Freljord'' while it is active will extend the duration by 4 seconds.

mechanics.claim: The same enemy cannot re-trigger Call of the Freljord for a cooldown period after triggering it.
mechanics.quote: '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' cannot trigger ''Call of the Freljord'' from the same enemy again for a time.

mechanics.claim: The cleave's splash damage can critically strike if the triggering basic attack crits, but does not gain other on-hit bonus damage, and does not itself apply on-hit spell effects.
mechanics.quote: The splash damage will critically strike when the basic attack does, but will not deal any bonus damage.

mechanics.claim: The cleave cone deals area damage as basic damage without triggering additional spell effects.
mechanics.quote: The cone deals {{tip|area damage|AoE}} {{tip|basic damage}} (though without applying {{tip|spell effects}}).
